title: PowerShell here-string transport for inline Python
failure_signature: A POSIX heredoc redirection token was rejected by PowerShell before the inline Python metadata query started.
candidate_workaround: Pipe a literal PowerShell here-string to python standard input for multi-line read-only queries.
recurrence_guard: Select shell-native multi-line transport before composing inline code and keep the query read-only.
rollback: Retain the parser failure, make no file change, and rerun only through the host shell's supported literal transport.
scope_boundary: Inline read-only query transport only; not a general shell-safety or validation-completeness claim.
